name: Create and Publish Reels & Shorts with NextCut and Dropbox

main.node: Read NextCut account and render status

parameters.content:
## Create and Publish Reels & Shorts with NextCut and Dropbox

### How it works
Turn supplied English narration, a public PCM WAV and two to five scenes into a vertical video using NextCut Free. A protected form or fictional example creates a saved job. The workflow validates the brief, checkpoints rendering, verifies the original MP4 and optionally archives it in Dropbox. A schedule delivers selected Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts. Saved provider IDs and delivery checkpoints support recovery and reconciliation of uncertain uploads.

### Setup
1. Use n8n with Data Tables and public HTTPS access. Connect NextCut Header Auth, Basic Auth for intake and recovery, and OAuth for your selected social accounts. Dropbox OAuth is optional.
2. Edit **Apply video configuration** with your HTTPS URL, table name, destination IDs, timezone and publishing hours. Match the two Schedule nodes to those settings.
3. Keep generation and publishing disabled while configuring. Run **Set up cloud storage** with manualAction set to setup. Change it to example to use the fictional brief; that example selects neither social destination.
4. Check API access and the intended accounts before enabling generation, publishing and the workflow. Verified NextCut Free quota and a public 16-bit PCM WAV are required. The generation allowance limits jobs, not spending.

### Customization
Choose explainer or slideshow scenes, licensed media, branding and captions. Automatic authorization is the default; enable requireVideoApproval for manual review. Configure Dropbox archiving separately. Output is a 396 x 704 MP4, up to 30 seconds, without a local rendering server. NextCut does not generate speech.

## Additional info

- [Full Notion documentation](https://paoloronco.notion.site/41bf0ba27c3281b5a38fe146d963960f)
- [Version-specific README and package files](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/social/video-production/V2/NextCut/README.md)
- [Detailed configuration and recovery](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/social/video-production/V2/NextCut/documentation.md)
